one_liner: Capture an idea in two taps, keep it forever, pay once.
problem: Note apps have become cluttered and subscription-gated; capturing a quick thought takes too many steps.

target_users.persona: Busy professional who jots ideas on the go

value_proposition: The calmest way to capture and revisit ideas, with a one-time Pro unlock.

differentiation.vs_competitors: Fixture Notes Pro and Fixture Mindbox need 4+ taps
Fixture Notes Pro and Fixture Paperlite require subscriptions

monetization_hypothesis.rationale: Users explicitly reject subscriptions for simple notes [S7].
